english.title: Prohibited acquisition of a specimen covered by the control of trade in endangered species regulations
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) acquired for commercial purposes

(A)_[a specimen]_
(B)_[specimens]_

of a species, namely **(..SPECIFY..), listed in Annex A to Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97 and in contravention of Article 8 of Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(1) and (8) of the Control of Trade in Endangered Species (Enforcement) Regulations 1997.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
acquire for commercial purposes a specimen

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Offence wording document is now OBSOLETE - amalgamated into CJS Code ES97011 and H14945 with effect from 31/12/12.

(i) See Regulation 8(3) and Article 8 of Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97 for conditions required for legal purchase, sale etc of specimens.
(ii) See Regulation 8(4) for defence of lack of knowledge of protected status of a species listed in Annex A of Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97.
(iii) See also associated offence wordings H2861, H2862, H2864, H2865, H2866, H2867, H2868 and H2869.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gwaharddedig - Caffael sbesimen rhywogaeth mewn perygl y rheolir y fasnach ynddi
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i chi gaffael at ddibenion masnachol

(A)_[sbesimen]_
(B)_[sbesimenau]_

rhywogaeth, sef **(..SPECIFY..), a restrir yn Atodiad A i Reoliad y Cyngor (EC ) Rhif 338/97 ac yn groes i Erthygl 8 o Reoliad y Cyngor (EC ) Rhif 338/97
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i reoliad 8(1) ac (8) o Reoliadau Rheoli Masnach mewn Rhywogaethau Mewn Perygl (Gorfodi) 1997.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
